shape: someone does a small thing for you and never mentions it; name that as love

slides.text: the soap dish was already full when i reached for it, i never had to pause, that's [[love]]

caption:
even a hard week feels smoother when the basics stay ready
a tiny refill can be a quiet breath of calm
send this to the housemate who always tops up the soap

#selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself
alt: a green donkey points right as the text describes the soap dish already being full, calling the quiet act love
